title: ID0452406-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S8 170003980] Activate the Modbus TCP
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Activate the Modbus TCP interface for the ELM on both columns.
Solution: Activate External Load Management option in SCB via Change configuration in PLC Configuration
yyyy-mm-dd: 2025-09-26
Worked by> Marcelo
